Name: StarDust's Maps Retexture
Author: StarDust0001
Description:
This is a mod I worked on for a while to improve Vanilla aesthetics. I'll add more things when I've time or I've any inspiration.
这是一个用来提升美学（？）的模组，对于一些我不太喜欢的材质进行了更改，会持续更新，如果我有时间的话（……）
Currently, it has:
Some new textures for festivals. For details, see the images above.
Retetexture for two merchants, the traveling merchant, and the desert merchant.
Retexture for all characters and ships at Night Market. (including our dear captain in the submarine. I forgot to take a screenshot for him, will do it later when I finish the other characters at festivals.)
目前涵盖：
一些节日的新材质，详情见图。
对旅行商人和沙漠商人的新贴图。
修改了夜市上所有船（除了旅行商人）的颜色，增加了一些装饰和积雪。

To-do List:
More retexture for All Souls' Night and other festivals.
A cuter texture for Dusty
A new altar ( Yes, I don't like the old one, let's say... it doesn't accurate enough)
New texture for that sculpture in the forest. Btw, is that a Star Wars Reference? 
A new traveling Cart for different festivals and four seasonal changes.
A new tent for the desert merchant.
A town retexture? (Maybe? that would need too much time)

Compatible MapRecolors: Vanilla, DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor, A Wittily Named Recolor, Way Back Pelican Town, Vibrant Pastoral Recolor.
Compatible Interior Recolors: Vanilla, Rustic Country Town Interior, Elegant Victorian Interior.

It was designed to use with Stardew Foliage Redone, although the original author has deleted that Map recolor.
You could find her foliage mod here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966

[i]Allow to make simple color adjustments for matching the Map recolor mods that don't exist in the options, but do not distribute the recolor you make or my own mod. Disallow editing any parts that have no relationship with recolors as well.
允许简单改色以匹配不在目前选项中的地图改色模组，但不允许重新分发个人制作的改色文件或者再上传我的模组，也不允许编辑其它与改色无关的部分。

[/i]If you want to add your recolor to the mod, you may contact me on Nexus.
如果你有自己制作的改色想要加进模组，你可以在Nexus告诉我。

Plz tell me if any bugs happen;)
有bug的话请在评论区告诉我！
